compact.name: booking
compact.sql: CREATE VIEW "booking" as select p."booking_id" AS "booking_id",p."user_id" AS "user_id",p."hotel_id" AS "hotel_id",p."room_id" AS "room_id",p."booking_status" AS "booking_status",p."booking_amount" AS "booking_amount",p."booking_at" AS "booking_at",p."checkin_date" AS "checkin_date",p."checkout_date" AS "checkout_date",p."guest_count" AS "guest_count",p."room_count" AS "room_count",p."cancellation_deadline" AS "cancellation_deadline" from "_data_booking" p

compact.name: event
compact.sql: CREATE VIEW "event" as select CASE WHEN p."event_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'SYN_E'||substr(printf('%09d',p."event_id"),1,4)||'_'||substr(printf('%09d',p."event_id"),5,5) END AS "event_id",(select "session_id" from _sessions where id=p._session_ref) AS "session_id",(select value from "_dict_event_event_type" where id=p."event_type") AS "event_type",(select value from "_dict_event_event_at" where id=p."event_at") AS "event_at",CASE WHEN p."hotel_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'H'||substr(printf('%04d',p."hotel_id"),1,4) END AS "hotel_id",replace((CASE WHEN p."search_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'SYN_Q'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_id"),1,4)||'_'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_id"),5,3) END),'SYN_Q','SYN_F') AS "search_filter_id",CASE WHEN p."search_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'SYN_Q'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_id"),1,4)||'_'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_id"),5,3) END AS "search_id",CASE WHEN p._user_present THEN (select "user_id" from _sessions where id=p._session_ref) ELSE NULL END AS "user_id",p."rating" AS "rating",CASE WHEN p._end_present THEN (select "session_end_time" from _sessions where id=p._session_ref) ELSE NULL END AS "session_end_time",p."review_completed_at" AS "review_completed_at",p."review_text" AS "review_text",(select value from "_dict_event_device" where id=p."device") AS "device" from "_data_event" p

compact.name: hotel
compact.sql: CREATE VIEW "hotel" as select CASE WHEN p."hotel_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'H'||substr(printf('%04d',p."hotel_id"),1,4) END AS "hotel_id",p."hotel_name" AS "hotel_name",p."city_name" AS "city_name",p."grade" AS "grade",p."hotel_address" AS "hotel_address",p."user_rating" AS "user_rating",p."review_count" AS "review_count",p."property_type" AS "property_type",p."actual_address" AS "actual_address",p."actual_city" AS "actual_city",p."actual_prefecture" AS "actual_prefecture",p."actual_postal_code" AS "actual_postal_code",p."actual_latitude" AS "actual_latitude",p."actual_longitude" AS "actual_longitude",p."actual_phone" AS "actual_phone",p."actual_star_rating" AS "actual_star_rating",p."supplier_hotel_code" AS "supplier_hotel_code",p."rtx_code" AS "rtx_code",p."agoda_code" AS "agoda_code",p."expedia_code" AS "expedia_code",p."top_selling_rank" AS "top_selling_rank",p."source_last_mapped_at" AS "source_last_mapped_at",(select value from "_dict_hotel_actual_data_sources" where id=p."actual_data_sources") AS "actual_data_sources" from "_data_hotel" p

compact.name: room
compact.sql: CREATE VIEW "room" as select CASE WHEN p."room_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'R'||substr(printf('%05d',p."room_id"),1,4)||'_'||substr(printf('%05d',p."room_id"),5,1) END AS "room_id",CASE WHEN p."hotel_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'H'||substr(printf('%04d',p."hotel_id"),1,4) END AS "hotel_id",p."guest_count" AS "guest_count",p."room_count" AS "room_count",(select value from "_dict_room_room_options" where id=p."room_options") AS "room_options",p."pay_later_flag" AS "pay_later_flag",p."free_cancel_flag" AS "free_cancel_flag",p."room_price" AS "room_price",(select value from "_dict_room_room_type" where id=p."room_type") AS "room_type" from "_data_room" p

compact.name: search
compact.sql: CREATE VIEW "search" as select CASE WHEN p."search_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'SYN_Q'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_id"),1,4)||'_'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_id"),5,3) END AS "search_id",CASE WHEN p."session_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'SYN_S'||substr(printf('%04d',p."session_id"),1,4) END AS "session_id",p."search_time" AS "search_time",(select value from "_dict_search_query_text" where id=p."query_text") AS "query_text",(select value from "_dict_search_checkin_date" where id=p."checkin_date") AS "checkin_date",(select value from "_dict_search_checkout_date" where id=p."checkout_date") AS "checkout_date",p."total_result_count" AS "total_result_count",(select value from "_dict_search_sort_option" where id=p."sort_option") AS "sort_option",p."guest_count" AS "guest_count",(select value from "_dict_search_destination" where id=p."destination") AS "destination" from "_data_search" p

compact.name: search_filter
compact.sql: CREATE VIEW "search_filter" as select CASE WHEN p."search_filter_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'SYN_F'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_filter_id"),1,4)||'_'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_filter_id"),5,3) END AS "search_filter_id",CASE WHEN p."search_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'SYN_Q'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_id"),1,4)||'_'||substr(printf('%07d',p."search_id"),5,3) END AS "search_id",p."property_type" AS "property_type",p."property_grade" AS "property_grade",p."user_rating_min" AS "user_rating_min",p."price" AS "price",p."amenity_count" AS "amenity_count",(select value from "_dict_search_filter_region" where id=p."region") AS "region" from "_data_search_filter" p

compact.name: search_result
compact.sql: CREATE VIEW search_result as select CASE WHEN search_result_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('SYN_R%04d_%03d_%04d',search_result_id/10000000,(search_result_id/10000)%1000,search_result_id%10000) END search_result_id,CASE WHEN search_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('SYN_Q%04d_%03d',search_id/1000,search_id%1000) END search_id,CASE WHEN room_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('H%04d',room_id/10) END hotel_id,CASE WHEN room_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('R%04d_%01d',room_id/10,room_id%10) END room_id,result_score,result_rank,price_rank from _data_search_result

compact.name: user
compact.sql: CREATE VIEW "user" as select CASE WHEN p."user_id" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'SYN_U'||substr(printf('%04d',p."user_id"),1,4) END AS "user_id",p."user_name" AS "user_name",p."age_group" AS "age_group",p."email" AS "email",p."signup_at" AS "signup_at" from "_data_user" p
